_comment: Plain, hand-editable lookup for GET /filing-guidance — no migration needed to add or correct an entry. portal_url is populated ONLY when directly fetched and visually confirmed live/correct (see backend/db/seed_data/filing_guides/ for the full walkthrough and verification notes/dates) — never guessed from a title or a search result. Left null when a state has no confirmed portal (e.g. Ogun — multiple candidate URLs found, none confirmable as canonical/live) or isn't listed at all. Because a government portal can move without notice, re-verify a URL before trusting it long-term rather than assuming it's still correct. guide_file names the matching full walkthrough in filing_guides/, served in the API response as guide_markdown. 'default' is returned for any state not listed below.

default.note: Filing deadlines and procedures are set by your State Internal Revenue Service (a separate body from the federal Nigeria Tax Act this app implements) — search for your state's official tax portal to file and confirm this year's deadline.

Lagos.note: Lagos State Internal Revenue Service's online filing portal.

FCT (Abuja).note: The FCT Internal Revenue Service's online filing portal. Verified live 2026-09-12 (FCT-IRS E-Tax login/session page).

Rivers.note: Rivers State's online tax administration portal. This address resolves to a bare redirect page with no RIVTAMIS branding visible — likely correct (matches the name used in state guidance) but not fully visually confirmed, so double-check you land on a RIVTAMIS-branded page after the redirect.

Oyo.note: Oyo State Board of Internal Revenue's self-service portal (issues your S-TIN). Verified live 2026-09-12 (S-TIN registration, filing, payment, and TCC verification all present). A paper registration route also exists if you'd rather register in person.

Osun.note: Osun Internal Revenue Service. Verified live 2026-09-12. Direct Assessment returns are filed via a downloadable Excel template (irs.os.gov.ng/downloads) submitted online or by email.

Ogun.note: Ogun State Internal Revenue Service. Multiple OGIRS web addresses are in circulation (ogunstaterevenue.com, ogirs.ogunstate.gov.ng, portal.ogetax.ogunstate.gov.ng); the last of these loads but shows signs of being stale (dead "#" links, a news section last updated 2021) rather than the current live system. No canonical portal could be confirmed as of 2026-09-12 — search "OGIRS Ogun State" and verify you're on the current official site before registering or filing.
